ده تا در این مورد اندیشه کنیم و جوابی آماده کنیم». فرمود: «شما مهلت دارید مشروط بر اینکه انصاف را از دست ندهید تا خدا هدایتتان نماید». سپس روی به مسیحیان آورد و فرمود: شما معتقدید که خدای قدیم با عیسی مسیح (علیه السلام) متحد گشته که پسر او شده است؟ منظورتان از این عقیده چیست؟ می‌گویید ذات قدیم و ازلی خدا به واس-طه اتّحاد با عیسی که خودش مخلوق است مخلوق شده، یا عیسی که خود آفریده‌ای است و سابقه عدمی داشته، به واسطه‌ی اتصال به خدا قدیم و ازلی شده است؟ یا منظورتان از این اتّحاد این است که خداوند او را مزیّت و مرتبه‌ای داده که به هیچ کس این مقام را نداده است. اگر می‌گویید خدای قدیم مخلوق است که این ادّعای باطلی است زیرا ذات قدیم و ازلی محال است که دگرگون شود و آفریده گردد. اگر بگویید عیسی قدیم و ازلی شده است که این هم محال است زیرا مخلوق نیز محال است قدیم و ازلی شود. اگر بگویید منظورتان از اتحاد این است که او را مزیتی بخشیده و از بین مردم ممتازش نموده، شما خود معترف شدید که عیسی (علیه السلام) آفریده شده است و این مقام و موقعیّت نیز قبلاً نبوده و بعد پیدا شده است، زیرا وقتی عیسی (علیه السلام) آفریده شده باشد و مقامی که به او داده است نیز بعد به وجود آمده باشد، هر دو محدث و مخلوقند و این مخالف ادعایی است که اوّل کردید». مسیحیان گفتند: «وقتی خداوند به دست عیسی (علیه السلام) آن معجزات را آشکار نموده، از جهت مقام و موقعیت او را فرزند خود خواند». پیامبر اکرم (صلی الله علیه و آله) فرمود: «شنیدید که در جواب یهود چه گفتم»؟ بعد همان فرمایش خود را تکرار کرد. همه سکوت کردند مگر یک نفر که گفت: «مگر شما معتقد نیستید که ابراهیم خلیل الله است». آن جناب فرمود: «آری». گفت: «پس چه اشکالی دارد که ما بگوییم عیسی (علیه السلام) پسر خدا است». پیامبر اکرم (صلی الله علیه و آله) فرمود: «این دو مثل هم نیستند، زیرا وقتی می‌گوییم ابراهیم خلیل الله است؛ یا لفظ خلیل از خله به معنی احتیاج و فقر گرفته شده، در این صورت می‌گوییم او محتاج و فقیر در خانه خدا است و از دیگران بی‌نیاز است. این معنی آشکار است، زیرا همان موقعی که خواستند او را در آتش اندازند و در منجنیق قرار دادند، خداوند به جبرئیل دستور داد که بنده‌ام ابراهیم را دریاب. او در وسط آسمان با ابراهیم (علیه السلام) ملاقات کرده، گفت، هر دستوری داری بگو که مرا برای یاری تو فرستاده‌اند. در جواب جبرئیل گفت، خدا کافی است و خوب نگهبانی است، من پناه به دیگری نمی‌برم و فقط به او عرض حاجت می‌کنم. پس خداوند او را خلیل خود نامید زیرا از دیگران بی‌نیاز و محتاج و فقیر درب خانه اوست. اگر خلیل را از خله بگیریم که معنی‌اش این است که بر اموری از اسرار اطلاع دارد که دیگری مطلع نیست این مقام موجب تشبیه خدا به خلق نمی‌شود. چنانچه می‌بینید که در هر یک از این دو معنی، وقتی ابراهیم محتاج به او نباشد خلیلش نیست یا وقتی عالم به اسرارش نباشد باز خلیل او نخواهد بود. ولی کسی که فرزند شخصی باشد و از او به وجود آمده باشد، گرچه به او اهانت نماید و او را از خودش دور کند، باز هم فرزند اوست زیرا مقام فرزندی ثابت است. از این گذشته، در صورتی که شما خلیل بودن را با فرزند بودن مقایسه کنید و بگویید عیسی (علیه السلام) پسر خدا است، لازم است همین مقام را به موسی (علیه السلام) نیز بدهید زیرا معجزات موسی (علیه السلام) کمتر از عی-سی (علیه السلام) نبوده، با وجود این معنی می‌توان گف-ت، س-رور و عم-و و فرم-انروا و امیر خ-دا نیز هستند چنانچه به یهودیان گفتم». در این موقع یکی از مسیحیان به دیگری گفت: «در کتابهای آسمانی آمده که عیسی (علیه السلام) گفت: پیش پدرم می‌روم». فرمود: «اگر شما به آن کتاب معتقد هستید، در آنجا گفته است، پیش پدر شما و خودم می‌روم، پس باید به همان دلیل که عیسی (علیه السلام) پسر خدا است، تمام کسانی که مخاطب عیسی (علیه السلام) در این سخن بوده‌اند پسر خدا باشند. علاوه بر این، اگر دلیل شما نوشته آن کتاب باشد، دیگر استدلال قبل را که گفتید به واسطه امتیاز و مقام بود که خدا این سمت را به او داده، باطل می‌شود، زیرا گفتید این فرزندی از جهت احترام و موقعیت عیسی (علیه السلام) بوده و خودتان می‌دانید که موقعیت عیسی (علیه السلام) را آن‌هایی که عیسی (علیه السلام) به ایشان گفت پیش پدر خود و شما می‌روم نداشتند. پس مقام فرزندی اختصاص به عیسی (علیه السلام) پیدا نمی‌کند با اینکه شما گفتار عیسی را بر خلاف منظورش تفسیر کردید. شاید منظور او این بوده که پیش آدم که پدر من و شما است می‌روم یا پیش نوح پیامبر (علیه السلام) و منظور عیسی (علیه السلام) غیر از این هم نبوده است». مسیحیان ساکت شدند و گفتند تاکنون با این استدلال و مناظره‌ای روبرو نشده بودیم، اجازه بده بیشتر در این باره فکر کنیم.
30.en:
It is narrated from the Commander of the Faithful, Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him), that one day, representatives of five religions gathered before the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family): the Jews, the Christians, the Dahriyyah (materialists), the Thanawiyyah (dualists), and the polytheists of the Arabs.

The Jews said, "We say that Uzayr is the son of God, and we have come to you, O Muhammad, to see what you say. If you follow us, we are more advanced in truth than you and superior; and if you oppose us, we will dispute with you."

The Christians said, "We say that the Messiah (peace be upon him) is the son of God, united with Him, and we have come to you to see what you say. If you follow us, we are more advanced in truth than you and superior; and if you oppose us, we will dispute with you."

The Dahriyyah said, "We say that things have no beginning and are eternal, and we have come to you to see what you say. If you follow us, we are more advanced in truth than you and superior; and if you oppose us, we will dispute with you."

The Thanawiyyah said, "We say that Light and Darkness are the two managers [of the universe], and we have come to you to see what you say. If you follow us, we are more advanced in truth than you; and if you oppose us, we will dispute with you."

The polytheists of the Arabs said, "We say that our idols are gods, and we have come to you to see what you say. If you follow us, we are more advanced in truth than you and superior; and if you oppose us, we will dispute with you."

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said, "I believe in Allah alone, with no partner, and I disbelieve in [the Jibt and the Taghut] and every object of worship besides Him." Then he said to them, "Allah the Exalted has sent me to all people as a bearer of glad tidings and a warner, and as a proof against the worlds, and He will soon cast the plot of those who plot against His religion back upon them."

Then he said to the Jews, "Have you come to me so that I may accept your statement without proof?" They said, "No." He said, "Then what has prompted you to say that Uzayr (peace be upon him) is the son of God?" They said, "Because he revived the Torah for the Children of Israel after it had been lost, and he would not have done that except that he is His son."

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said, "Then how did Uzayr (peace be upon him) become the son of God instead of Moses (peace be upon him), who brought them the Torah and from whom you saw the miracles you know of? If Uzayr (peace be upon him) is the son of God because of the honor shown to him by reviving the Torah, then Moses (peace be upon him) was more worthy and deserving of prophethood. And if this degree of honor for Uzayr (peace be upon him) necessitates that he is His son, then the manifold honors of Moses (peace be upon him) would necessitate a status for him even greater than prophethood. If you mean by 'sonship' the literal meaning you observe in your world—the birth of children from mothers through the intercourse of their fathers—then you have disbelieved in Allah, likened Him to His creation, and attributed to Him the qualities of created beings. Thus, according to you, He would have to be created, and He would have a creator who fashioned and originated Him."

They said, "We do not mean this, for that is disbelief, as you have pointed out. Rather, we mean that he is His son in the sense of honor, even if there is no birth, just as some of our scholars say to someone they wish to honor and distinguish in status above others, 'O my son,' and 'He is my son,' not to prove biological descent, for he may say this to a stranger with whom he has no lineage. Likewise, when Allah the Exalted did what He did with Uzayr (peace be upon him), He took him as a son in the sense of honor, not birth."

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said, "This is what I said to you: if it is necessary on this basis that Uzayr be His son, then this status is more appropriate for Moses (peace be upon him). Allah exposes every falsifier through their own admission and turns their argument against them. What you have argued with leads you to something even greater than what I have mentioned to you, because you said that a great one among you may say to a stranger with whom he has no lineage, 'O my son,' and 'This is my son,' not by way of birth. You also find this great one saying to a stranger, 'This is my brother,' and to another, 'This is my elder and my father,' and to another, 'This is my brother,' and to another, 'This is my master,' and 'O my master,' by way of honor. And whoever increases in honor, he increases such statements. Therefore, it is permissible according to you for Moses (peace be upon him) to be a brother to God, or an elder to Him, or a father, or a master, because He increased his honor beyond that of Uzayr, just as one who increases a man's honor says to him, 'O my master, O my elder, O my uncle, O my leader' by way of honor. If you increase his honor, you increase such statements. So, is it permissible according to you for Moses (peace be upon him) to be a brother to God, or an elder, or an uncle, or a leader, or a master, or a commander, because He increased his honor over the one to whom He said, 'O my elder, or O my master, or O my uncle, or O my leader, or O my commander'?"

The people were stunned and bewildered and said, "O Muhammad, give us time to reflect on what you have said to us." He said, "Reflect upon it with hearts committed to fairness, and Allah will guide you."

Then he (peace be upon him and his family) turned to the Christians and said to them, "And you, you said that the Ancient, Majestic and Exalted, united with the Messiah (peace be upon him), His son. What did you intend by this statement? Did you intend that the Ancient became created due to the existence of this created being, who is Jesus (peace be upon him)? Or that the created being, who is Jesus (peace be upon him), became ancient like the existence of the Ancient, who is Allah? Or does your statement that He 'united with him' mean that He singled him out with an honor with which He did not honor anyone else? If you intend that the Ancient became created, you have invalidated your claim, for it is impossible for the Ancient to change and become created. If you intend that the created became ancient, you have proposed an absurdity, for it is also impossible for the created to become ancient. If you intend that He united with him by singling him out and choosing him over the rest of His servants, then you have admitted to the created nature of Jesus (peace be upon him) and the created nature of the 'meaning' by which He united with him. For if Jesus (peace be upon him) is created, and Allah united with him by creating within him a meaning by which he became the most honored of creation in His sight, then Jesus (peace be upon him) and that meaning have both become created, and this is contrary to what you began by saying."

The Christians said, "O Muhammad, when Allah manifested the wondrous things He manifested at the hands of Jesus (peace be upon him), He took him as a son by way of honor." The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said to them, "You have heard what I said to the Jews regarding this meaning you have mentioned." Then he (peace be upon him and his family) repeated all of it, and they fell silent, except for one man among them who said to him, "O Muhammad, do you not say that Abraham (peace be upon him) is the Friend (Khalil) of Allah?" He said, "We have said that." He said, "If you say that, then why do you forbid us from saying that Jesus (peace be upon him) is the son of God?"

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said, "The two are not similar, because our saying 'Abraham (peace be upon him) is the Friend of Allah' is derived from *khullah* (friendship/need). *Khullah* means poverty and need. He was a friend to his Lord, needy and cut off from all others, abstaining and turning away from anyone else, finding sufficiency in Him. This was when they wanted to throw him into the fire, and he was cast into the catapult. Allah sent Gabriel (peace be upon him), who said to him, 'Reach out to my servant.' He came and met him in the air and said to him, 'Charge me with whatever you wish, for Allah has sent me to assist you.' Abraham (peace be upon him) said, 'Allah is sufficient for me, and He is the best Disposer of affairs. I do not ask anyone else, and I have no need except for Him.' So He named him His Friend (Khalil), meaning his needy and destitute one, the one cut off from all others for His sake. And if the meaning of this is taken from *khullah* as meaning that he penetrated His meanings and stood upon secrets that no one else stood upon, then 'Friend' means the one who knows Him and His affairs, and this does not necessitate likening Allah to His creation. Do you not see that if he were not cut off for Him, he would not be His Friend, and if he did not know His secrets, he would not be His Friend? But one whom a man begets, even if he insults him and casts him away, does not cease to be his son, because the meaning of birth is established in him. Furthermore, if it were necessary, because He said to Abraham (peace be upon him), 'My Friend,' for you to analogize and say that Jesus (peace be upon him) is His son, then it would also be necessary for you to say to Moses (peace be upon him) that he is His son, for the miracles he had were not less than what Jesus (peace be upon him) had. So say that Moses (peace be upon him) is also His son, and that it is permissible for you to say on this basis that He is his elder, his master, his uncle, his leader, and his commander, just as I mentioned to the Jews."

Some of them said to others, "And in the revealed books, it is written that Jesus (peace be upon him) said, 'I am going to my Father and your Father.'" The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said, "If you know by that book, then it says in it, 'I am going to my Father and your Father.' So say that all those whom Jesus (peace be upon him) addressed were sons of God, just as Jesus (peace be upon him) was His son in the way that Jesus (peace be upon him) was His son. Furthermore, in this book, there is a refutation of what you claimed—that Jesus (peace be upon him) was His son by way of exclusivity—because you said, 'We only said he is His son because He singled him out with what He did not single out anyone else.' And you know that the thing with which Jesus (peace be upon him) was singled out was not granted to these people to whom Jesus (peace be upon him) said, 'I am going to my Father and your Father.' Thus, it is invalidated that the exclusivity belongs to Jesus (peace be upon him), because it has been established according to you by the statement of Jesus (peace be upon him) to those who did not have the same exclusivity as Jesus (peace be upon him). You have merely narrated the words of Jesus (peace be upon him) and interpreted them in a way other than their intended meaning. For when he said, 'I am going to my Father and your Father,' he intended something other than what you have gone to and attributed to him. What makes you know? Perhaps he meant, 'I am going to Adam (peace be upon him) or to Noah (peace be upon him), and Allah is raising me to them and gathering me with them,' and Adam (peace be upon him) is my father and your father, and likewise Noah (peace be upon him). Indeed, he intended nothing other than this."

The Christians fell silent and said, "We have never seen a debater or an adversary like you today, and we shall reflect upon our affairs."
30.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 6, p. 104
30.refs: Al-Ihtijaj, Vol. 1, p. 22 / Al-Burhan / Nur al-Thaqalayn

30.ar: إِنَّ أُنَاساً تَکَلَّمُوا فِی هَذَا الْقُرْآنِ بِغَیْرِ عِلْم ... وَ قَوْلُهُ وَ ما أَضَلَّنا إِلَّا الْمُجْرِمُونَ یَعْنِی الْمُشْرِکِینَ الَّذِینَ اقْتَدَوْا بِهِمْ هَؤُلَاءِ فَاتَّبَعُوهُمْ عَلَی شِرْکِهِمْ وَ هُمْ قَوْمُ مُحَمَّدٍ (صلی الله علیه و آله) لَیْسَ فِیهِمْ مِنَ الْیَهُودِ وَ النَّصَارَی أَحَدٌ وَ تَصْدِیقُ ذَلِکَ قَوْلُ اللَّهِ عَزَّوَجَلَّ کَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ. کَذَّبَ أَصْحابُ الْأَیْکَةِ. کَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍ لَیْسَ هُمُ الْیَهُودُ الَّذِینَ قَالُوا عُزَیْرٌ ابْنُ اللهِ وَ لَا النَّصَارَی الَّذِینَ قَالُوا الْمَسِیحُ ابْنُ اللهِ سَیُدْخِلُ اللَّهُ الْیَهُودَ وَ النَّصَارَی النَّارَ وَ یُدْخِلُ کُلَّ قَوْمٍ بِأَعْمَالِهِمْ وَ قَوْلُهُمْ وَ ما أَضَلَّنا إِلَّا الْمُجْرِمُونَ إِذْ دَعَوْنَا إِلَی سَبِیلِهِمْ ذَلِکَ قَوْلُ اللَّهِ عَزَّوَجَلَّ فِیهِمْ حِینَ جَمَعَهُمْ إِلَی النَّارِ قالَتْ أُولَاهُمْ لِأُخْرَاهُمْ رَبَّنا هؤُلاءِ أَضَلُّونا فَآتِهِمْ عَذاباً ضِعْفاً مِنَ النَّارِ وَ قَوْلُهُ کُلَّما دَخَلَتْ أُمَّةٌ لَعَنَتْ أُخْتَها حَتَّی إِذَا ادَّارَکُوا فِیها جَمِیعاً بَرِئَ بَعْضُهُمْ مِنْ بَعْضٍ وَ لَعَنَ بَعْضُهُمْ بَعْضاً یُرِیدُ بَعْضُهُمْ أَنْ یُحَجِّجَ بَعْضاً رَجَاءَ الْفَلْجِ فَیُفْلِتُوا مِنْ عَظِیمِ مَا نَزَلَ بِهِمْ وَ لَیْسَ بِأَوَانِ بَلْوَی وَ لَا اخْتِبَارٍ وَ لَا قَبُولِ مَعْذِرَةٍ وَ لَا حِینَ نَجَاةٍ وَ الْآیَاتُ وَ أَشْبَاهُهُنَّ مِمَّا نَزَلَ بِهِ بِمَکَّةَ وَ لَا یُدْخِلُ اللَّهُ النَّارَ إِلَّا مُشْرِکاً.
30.en: A group of people have spoken about this Quran without knowledge... And His saying: "And none misled us except the criminals" (26:99) refers to the polytheists whom these people followed and imitated in their polytheism. They are the people of Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family), and there is not a single Jew or Christian among them. The confirmation of this is the saying of Allah, the Almighty and Majestic: "The people of Noah denied before them" (54:9), "The companions of the thicket denied" (26:176), and "The people of Lot denied" (26:160). They are not the Jews who said, "Uzair is the son of Allah," nor the Christians who said, "The Messiah is the son of Allah." Allah will cause the Jews and the Christians to enter the Fire, and He will cause every people to enter it according to their deeds. Their saying, "And none misled us except the criminals," refers to when they invited us to their path. This is the saying of Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, regarding them when He gathers them into the Fire: "Our Lord, these misled us, so give them a double punishment of the Fire" (7:38). And His saying: "Every time a nation enters, it curses its sister-nation, until when they have all overtaken one another therein, the last of them will say of the first of them, 'Our Lord, these misled us...'" (7:38). Some of them disavow others and some curse others; each wants to argue against the other in the hope of prevailing, so that they might escape the great calamity that has befallen them. But it is not a time for trial, nor for testing, nor for the acceptance of excuses, nor a time for salvation. These verses and those similar to them were revealed in Mecca, and Allah does not cause anyone to enter the Fire except a polytheist.
30.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 6, p. 110

30.ar: عَنْ یَزِیدَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْمَلِکِ عَنْ أَبِی عَبْدِ اللهِ (علیه السلام) قَالَ إِنَّهُ لَنْ یَغْضَبَ لِلَّهِ شَیْءٌ کَغَضَبِ الطَّلْحِ وَ السِّدْرِ إِنَّ الطَّلْحَ کَانَتْ کَالْأُتْرُجِّ وَ السِّدْرَ کَالْبِطِّیخِ فَلَمَّا قَالَتِ الْیَهُودُ یَدُ اللهِ مَغْلُولَةٌ أَنْقَصَتَا حِمْلَهُمَا فَصَغُرَ فَصَارَ لَهُ عَجَمٌ وَ اشْتَدَّ الْعَجَمُ فَلَمَّا أَنْ قَالَتِ النَّصَارَی الْمَسِیحُ ابْنُ اللهِ أَذْعَرَتَا فَخَرَجَ لَهُمَا هَذَا الشَّوْکُ وَ نَقَصَتَا حِمْلَهُمَا وَ صَارَ النَّبِقُ إِلَی هَذَا الْحِمْلِ وَ ذَهَبَ حِمْلُ الطَّلْحِ فَلَا یَحْمِلُ حَتَّی یَقُومَ قَائِمُنَا (عجل الله تعالی فرجه الشریف) أَوْ تَقُومَ السَّاعَةُ قَالَ مَنْ سَقَی طَلْحَةً أَوْ سِدْرَةً فَکَأَنَّمَا سَقَی مُؤْمِناً مِنْ ظِمَاءٍ.
30.fa: یزیدبن‌عبدالملک از امام صادق (علیه السلام) نقل می‌کند که فرمود: «هرگز خداوند به چیزی همچون خشم بر درخت طلح و سدر خشم نکرد. طلح، میوه‌ای همچون پرتقال داشت و سدر میوه‌ای چون خربزه داشت و زمانی‌که یهود گفتند: «دست خدا [با زنجیر] بسته است». دست‌هایشان بسته باد!. (مائده۶۴)، میوه‌هاشان خرد شد و هسته‌دار ش-د و هسته‌شان سخ-ت شد و چون نصاری گفتند: مسیح پسر خدا است لرزیدند و خار برآوردند و میوه‌شان کاسته شد و به صورت کنونی درآمد و طلح به کلی بی‌میوه شد و میوه نیاورد تا قائم ما (عجل الله تعالی فرجه الشریف) ظهور کند و قیامت برپا شود». و فرمود: «هرکه یک درخت طلح یا سدر را آب دهد گویا که مؤمنی را آب داده است».
30.en: Yazid ibn Abd al-Malik narrates from Abu Abd Allah (peace be upon him) who said: "God is never angered by anything as He is angered by the Talh (acacia/banana tree) and the Sidr (lote tree). The Talh used to have fruit like a citron, and the Sidr had fruit like a melon. When the Jews said, 'The hand of God is chained,' they [the trees] diminished their yield, became small, developed pits, and the pits became hard. When the Christians said, 'The Messiah is the son of God,' they [the trees] shuddered, grew these thorns, and their yield decreased until the Nabq (fruit of the Sidr) became what it is now, and the fruit of the Talh disappeared. It will not bear fruit until our Qa'im (may God hasten his noble relief) rises or the Hour arrives." He said: "Whoever waters a Talh or a Sidr tree, it is as if he has given a thirsty believer a drink."
30.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 6, p. 110
30.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 63, p. 113; Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 9, p. 212; al-Burhan; Nur al-Thaqalayn

30.ar: إِنَّ الشَّجَرَ لَمْ یَزَلْ حَصِیداً کُلُّهُ حَتَّی دُعِیَ لِلرَّحْمَنِ وَلَدٌ عَزَّ الرَّحْمَنُ وَ جَلَّ أَنْ یَکُونَ لَهُ وَلَدٌ ... فَعِنْدَ ذَلِکَ اقْشَعَرَّ الشَّجَرُ وَ صَارَ لَهُ شَوْکٌ حذارا حَذَراً أَنْ یَنْزِلَ بِهِ الْعَذَابُ.
30.fa: هر درختی پیوسته بار چیدنی داشت تا برای خدا فرزند ادّعا شد، خداوند منزّه و با عزّت است از اینکه فرزندی داشته باشد، ... در این هنگام درخت لرزید و خار برآورد از ترس اینکه به خاطر این سخن عذاب نازل شود.
30.en: Every tree used to be entirely harvestable [without thorns] until a child was claimed for the Most Gracious. Exalted and Majestic is the Most Gracious above having a child... At that moment, the trees shuddered and grew thorns, fearing that the punishment might descend upon them.
30.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 6, p. 112
30.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 55, p. 22; Nur al-Thaqalayn

30.ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ اشْتَدَّ غَضَبَهُ عَلَی الْیَهُودِ أَنْ قَالُوا عُزَیْرٌ ابْنُ اللهِ، وَ اشْتَدَّ غَضَبُهُ عَلَی النَّصَارَی أَنْ قَالُوا الْمَسِیحُ ابْنُ اللهِ، وَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ اشْتَدَّ غَضَبُهُ عَلَی مَنْ أَرَاقَ دَمِی وَ آذَانِی فِی عِتْرَتِی.
30.fa: خشم خدا بر یهود هنگامی شدّت گرفت که گفتند: «عُزَیْرٌ ابْنُ اللهِ و خشم خدا بر مسیحیان هنگامی شدّت گرفت که گفتند: الْمَسِیحُ ابْنُ اللهِ و خشم خدا بر کسی که خون مرا ریخت و مرا از طریق آزاررساندن به عترتم آزار داد، بسیار شد».
30.en: God’s wrath intensified against the Jews when they said, "Ezra is the son of God," and His wrath intensified against the Christians when they said, "The Messiah is the son of God." And God’s wrath intensified against whoever shed my blood and harmed me by harming my progeny (itrah).
30.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 6, p. 112
30.refs: Al-Amali, p. 142; Al-Burhan; Nur al-Thaqalayn; Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 72, p. 206

30.ar: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَنْصُورٍ وَ کَانَ رَضِیعاً لِبَعْضِ وُلْدِ زَیْدٍ بْنِ عَلِیٍّ (علیه السلام) قَالَ سَأَلْتُ جَعْفَرَ بْنَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِیِّ بْنِ الْحُسَیْنِ (علیه السلام) فَقُلْتُ حَدِّثْنِی عَنْ مَقْتَلِ ابْنِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) ... فَأَخَذَ الْحُسَیْنُ (علیه السلام) بِطَرَفِ لِحْیَتِهِ وَ هُوَ یَوْمَئِذٍ ابْنُ سَبْعٍ وَ خَمْسِینَ سَنَةً ثُمَّ قَالَ اشْتَدَّ غَضَبُ اللَّهِ عَلَی الْیَهُودِ حِینَ قَالُوا عُزَیْرٌ ابْنُ اللهِ وَ اشْتَدَّ غَضَبُ اللَّهِ عَلَی النَّصَارَی حِینَ قَالُوا الْمَسِیحُ ابْنُ اللَّهِ وَ اشْتَدَّ غَضَبُ اللَّهِ عَلَی الْمَجُوسِ حِینَ عَبَدُوا النَّارَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ وَ اشْتَدَّ غَضَبُ اللَّهِ عَلَی قَوْمٍ قَتَلُوا نَبِیَّهُمْ وَ اشْتَدَّ غَضَبُ اللَّهِ عَلَی هَذِهِ الْعِصَابَةِ الَّذِینَ یُرِیدُونَ قَتْلِی{قَتْلَ} ابْنِ نَبِیِّهِم.
30.fa: عبدالله‌بن‌منصور که فرزند رضاعی یکی از فرزندان زیدبن‌علی (علیه السلام) است گوید: از امام صادق (علیه السلام) سؤالی پرسیدم و گفتم: «برایم از مقتل پسر رسول خدا (صلی الله علیه و آله) بگو». ... فرمود: «امام حسین (علیه السلام) که آن روز پنجاه‌وهفت ساله بود محاسن مبارک خود را گرفت و فرمود: هنگامی‌که ملّت یهود گفتند: عُزَیْرٌ ابْنُ اللهِ غضب خدا بر آنان شدید شد. موقعی‌که مسیحیان گفتند: الْمَسِیحُ ابْنُ اللهِ؛ خشم خدا بر ایشان زیاد گردید. وقتی گروه مجوس آتش‌پرست شدند غضب خدا بر آنان شدّت یافت. غضب خدا بر آن گروهی که پیغمبر خود را شهید کردند شدید گردید؛ غضب خدا بر این گروهی که تصمیم دارند پسر پیامبر خود را شهید نمایند شدید خواهد شد».
30.en: From ‘Abd Allah ibn Mansur, who was a foster brother to one of the children of Zayd ibn ‘Ali (peace be upon him), who said: I asked Ja‘far ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Ali ibn al-Husayn (peace be upon him) and said, "Tell me about the martyrdom of the son of the Messenger of Allah (blessings of Allah be upon him and his family)..." He said: Al-Husayn (peace be upon him) took hold of his beard—and he was fifty-seven years old on that day—then he said: "The wrath of Allah intensified against the Jews when they said, 'Uzayr is the son of Allah,' and the wrath of Allah intensified against the Christians when they said, 'The Messiah is the son of Allah,' and the wrath of Allah intensified against the Magians when they worshipped fire instead of Allah, and the wrath of Allah intensified against the people who killed their Prophet, and the wrath of Allah will intensify against this group who intend to kill me, the son of their Prophet."
30.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 6, p. 112

30.ar: أَیُّهَا النَّاسُ اتَّقُوا هَؤُلَاءِ الْمَارِقَةَ الَّذِینَ یُشَبِّهُونَ اللَّهَ بِأَنْفُسِهِمْ یُضاهِؤُنَ قَوْلَ الَّذِینَ کَفَرُوا مِنْ أَهْلِ الْکِتَابِ بَلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ لَیْسَ کَمِثْلِهِ شَیْءٌ وَ هُوَ السَّمِیعُ الْبَصِیرُ. لا تُدْرِکُهُ الْأَبْصارُ وَ هُوَ یُدْرِکُ الْأَبْصارَ وَ هُوَ اللَّطِیفُ الْخَبِیرُ اسْتَخْلَصَ الْوَحْدَانِیَّةَ وَ الْجَبَرُوتَ وَ أَمْضَی الْمَشِیَّةَ وَ الْإِرَادَةَ وَ الْقُدْرَةَ وَ الْعِلْمَ بِمَا هُوَ کَائِنٌ لَا مُنَازِعَ لَهُ فِی شَیْءٍ مِنْ أَمْرِهِ وَ لَا کُفْوَ لَهُ یُعَادِلُهُ وَ لَا ضِدَّ لَهُ یُنَازِعُهُ وَ لَا سَمِیَّ لَهُ یُشَابِهُهُ وَ لَا مِثْلَ لَهُ یُشَاکِلُهُ لَا تَتَدَاوَلُهُ الْأُمُورُ وَ لَا تَجْرِی عَلَیْهِ الْأَحْوَالُ وَ لَا تَنْزِلُ عَلَیْهِ الْأَحْدَاثُ وَ لَا یَقْ-دِرُ الْوَاصِفُونَ کُنْهَ عَظَمَتِهِ وَ لَا یَخْطُرُ عَلَی الْقُلُوبِ مَبْلَغُ جَبَرُوتِهِ لِأَنَّهُ لَیْسَ لَهُ فِی الْأَشْیَاءِ عَدِیلٌ وَ لَا تُدْرِکُهُ الْعُلَمَاءُ بِأَلْبَابِهَا وَ لَا أَهْلُ التَّفْکِیرِ بِتَفْکِیرِهِمْ إِلَّا بِالتَّحْقِیقِ إِیقَاناً بِالْغَیْبِ لِأَنَّهُ لَا یُوصَفُ بِشَیْءٍ مِنْ صِفَاتِ الْمَخْلُوقِینَ وَ هُوَ الْوَاحِدُ الصَّمَدُ مَا تُصُوِّرَ فِی الْأَوْهَامِ فَهُوَ خِلَافُهُ لَیْسَ بِرَبٍّ مَنْ طُرِحَ تَحْتَ الْبَلَاغِ وَ مَعْبُودٍ مَنْ وُجِدَ فِی هَوَاءٍ أَوْ غَیْرِ هَوَاءٍ هُوَ فِی الْأَشْیَاءِ کَائِنٌ لَا کَیْنُونَةَ مَحْظُورٍ بِهَا عَلَیْهِ وَ مِنَ الْأَشْیَاءِ بَائِنٌ لَا بَیْنُونَةَ غَائِبٍ عَنْهَا لَیْسَ بِقَادِرٍ مَنْ قَارَنَهُ ضِدٌّ أَوْ سَاوَاهُ نِدٌّ لَیْسَ عَنِ الدَّهْرِ قِدَمُهُ وَ لَا بِالنَّاحِیَةِ أَمَمُهُ احْتَجَبَ عَنِ الْعُقُولِ کَمَا احْتَجَبَ عَنِ الْأَبْصَارِ وَ عَمَّنْ فِی السَّمَاءِ احْتِجَابَهُ عَمَّنْ فِی الْأَرْضِ قُرْبُهُ کَرَامَتُهُ وَ بُعْدُهُ إِهَانَتُهُ لَا یُحِلُّهُ فِی وَ لَا تُوَقِّتُهُ إِذْ وَ لَا تُؤَامِرُهُ إِنْ عُلُوُّهُ مِنْ غَیْرِ نَوْقَلٍ {تَوَقُّلٍ} وَ مَجِیؤُهُ مِنْ غَیْرِ تَنَقُّلٍ یُوجِدُ الْمَفْقُودَ وَ یُفْقِدُ الْمَوْجُودَ وَ لَا تَجْتَمِعُ لِغَیْرِهِ الصِّفَتَانِ فِی وَقْتٍ یُصِیبُ الْفِکْرُ مِنْهُ الْإِیمَانَ بِهِ مَوْجُوداً وَ وُجُودَ الْإِیمَانِ لَا وُجُودَ صِفَةٍ بِهِ تُوصَفُ الصِّفَاتُ لَا بِهَا یُوصَفُ وَ بِهِ تُعْرَفُ الْمَعَارِفُ لَا بِهَا یُعْرَفُ فَذَلِکَ اللَّهُ لَا سَمِیَّ لَهُ سُبْحَانَهُ لَیْسَ کَمِثْلِهِ شَیْءٌ وَ هُوَ السَّمِیعُ الْبَصِیرُ.
30.en: O people, beware of these renegades who liken God to themselves, echoing the words of those who disbelieved among the People of the Book. Rather, He is Allah; there is nothing like unto Him, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing. Vision perceives Him not, but He perceives all vision; and He is the Subtle, the Acquainted. He has reserved for Himself Oneness and Majesty, and has ordained His Will, Intent, Power, and Knowledge regarding all that is to be. He has no contender in any of His affairs, no equal to match Him, no adversary to oppose Him, no namesake to resemble Him, and no likeness to match Him. Affairs do not circulate through Him, states do not pass over Him, and events do not descend upon Him. Those who describe Him can never grasp the essence of His greatness, nor can the extent of His majesty cross the hearts of men, for He has no peer among things. Neither the scholars with their intellects nor the thinkers with their thoughts can grasp Him, except through the verification of faith in the Unseen, for He is not described by any of the attributes of the created. He is the One, the Eternal Refuge (al-Samad). Whatever is imagined in the mind, He is the opposite of it. He is not a Lord who is brought under the reach of human perception, nor is He a deity who is found within air or other than air. He is present in all things, but not in a way that implies He is confined by them; and He is separate from all things, but not in a way that implies He is absent from them. He is not powerful if a contrary force accompanies Him or an equal matches Him. His eternity is not derived from time, and His direction is not limited to a side. He is veiled from intellects just as He is veiled from sight; He is as hidden from those in the heavens as He is from those on the earth. His nearness is His honor, and His distance is His disdain. He is not contained by "in," nor is He timed by "when," nor is He conditioned by "if." His loftiness is without ascent, and His coming is without movement. He brings the non-existent into being and causes the existent to cease, and these two attributes do not combine for any other than Him at the same time. The share of thought regarding Him is only to attain faith in His existence—the existence of faith, not the existence of an attribute. By Him, attributes are described, but He is not described by them; through Him, knowledge is known, but He is not known through knowledge. Thus is Allah; there is no namesake for Him. Exalted is He; there is nothing like unto Him, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing.
30.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 6, p. 112

30.ar: یُضَاهِؤُنَ قَوْلَ الَّذِینَ کَفَرُوا أَیْ عُبَّادِ الْأَصْنَامِ فِی عِبَادَتِهِمْ لَهَا أَوْ فِی عِبَادَتِهِمْ لِلْمَلَائِکَةِ.
30.fa: یُضاهِؤُنَ قَوْلَ الَّذِینَ کَفَرُوا یعنی [گفتار] بت‌پرستان درباره‌ی پرستش بت‌هایشان یا درباره‌ی پرستش فرشتگان [را می‌گویند].
30.en: "They imitate the saying of those who disbelieved," meaning [they say] what the idolaters say regarding the worship of their idols or regarding the worship of the angels.
30.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 6, p. 114

30.ar: وَ مِنْ کِتَابِ اللَّهِ عَزَّوَجَلَّ مَا یَکُونُ تَأْوِیلُهُ عَلَی غَیْرِ تَنْزِیلِهِ وَ لَا یُشْبِهُ تَأْوِیلُهُ کَلَامَ الْبَشَرِ وَ لَا فِعْلَ الْبَشَرِ وَ سَأُنَبِّئُکَ بِمِثَالٍ لِذَلِکَ تَکْتَفِی بِهِ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّه ... وَ قَالَ قاتَلَهُمُ اللهُ أَنَّی یُؤْفَکُونَ أَیْ لَعَنَهُمُ اللَّهُ أَنَّی یُؤْفَکُونَ فَسَمَّی اللَّعْنَةَ قِتَالا وَ کَذَلِکَ قُتِلَ الإنسَانُ مَا أکْفَرَهُ أیْ لُعِنَ الإنْسَانُ.
30.en: And from the Book of Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, there are matters whose interpretation (ta'wil) is different from their revelation (tanzil), and their interpretation does not resemble the speech of humans nor the actions of humans. I will inform you of an example of that which will suffice you, if Allah wills... And He said: "May Allah destroy them; how are they deluded?" (9:30), meaning: May Allah curse them; how are they deluded? Thus, He named the curse "killing" (qital). Likewise: "Cursed is man! How ungrateful he is!" (80:17), meaning: Man is cursed.
30.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 6, p. 114
30.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 90, p. 114; Al-Ihtijaj, Vol. 1, p. 250; Al-Burhan; Nur al-Thaqalayn

30.fa: قَاتَلَهُمُ اللهُ، یعنی خدا آنان را لعن کرده است.
30.en: "May Allah destroy them" (Qatalahumullah), meaning: May Allah curse them.
30.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 6, p. 114

31.ar: عَنْ أَبِی بَصِیرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ (علیه السلام) عَنْ قَوْلِ اللَّهِ اتَّخَذُوا أَحْبارَهُمْ وَ رُهْبانَهُمْ أَرْباباً مِنْ دُونِ اللهِ فَقَال أَمَا وَ اللَّهِ مَا دَعَوْهُمْ إِلَی عِبَادَةِ أَنْفُسِهِمْ وَ لَوْ دَعَوْهُمْ مَا أَجَابُوهُمْ وَ لَکِنْ أَحَلُّوا لَهُمْ حَرَاماً وَ حَرَّمُوا عَلَیْهِمْ حَلَالًا فَعَبَدُوهُمْ مِنْ حَیْثُ لَا یَشْعُرُونَ.
31.fa: ابوبصیر گوید: از امام صادق (علیه السلام) درباره‌ی آیه: اتَّخَذُوا أَحْبارَهُمْ وَ رُهْبانَهُمْ أَرْباباً مِنْ دُونِ اللهِ، پرسیدم، فرمود: «به خدا سوگند! دانشمندان و راهبان یهود مردم را برای عبادت خودشان دعوت نکردند و اگر چنین کاری را می‌کردند، مردم از آن‌ها نمی‌پذیرفتند؛ ولی حلال خدا را برای آن‌ها حرام و حرام خدا را حلال کردند، پس ناخودآگاه، آن‌ها دانشمندان و راهبان را پرستیدند».
31.en: Abu Basir narrated: I asked Abu Abd Allah (peace be upon him) about the saying of Allah: "They have taken their scholars and monks as lords besides Allah." He said: "By Allah, they did not call them to worship themselves, and had they called them to do so, they would not have answered them. However, they made the forbidden lawful for them and the lawful forbidden for them, so they worshipped them without realizing it."
31.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 6, p. 116
31.refs: Al-Kafi, Vol. 1, p. 53; Al-Mahasin, Vol. 1, p. 246; Nur al-Thaqalayn; Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 2, p. 98; Al-Kafi, Vol. 2, p. 398; Wasa'il al-Shi'ah 27, p. 124; Al-Burhan

31.ar: وَ اللَّهِ مَا صَامُوا لَهُمْ وَ لَا صَلَّوْا لَهُمْ وَ لَکِنْ أَحَلُّوا لَهُمْ حَرَاماً وَ حَرَّمُوا عَلَیْهِمْ حَلَالًا فَاتَّبَعُوهُمْ.
31.fa: قسم به خدا برای آنان نماز نخواندند و روزه نگرفتند، بلکه حرامی را (کار حرام) برای آنان حلال و حلالی را حرام دانستند و از آنان پیروی کردند.
31.en: By Allah, they did not fast for them, nor did they pray for them; rather, they made the forbidden (haram) lawful for them, and they made the lawful (halal) forbidden for them, and so they followed them.
31.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 6, p. 116
31.refs: Al-Kafi, Vol. 1, p. 53; Nur al-Thaqalayn; Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 24, p. 246; Al-Ayyashi, Vol. 2, p. 86; Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 2, p. 98; Al-Burhan

31.ar: وَ اللَّهِ مَا صَامُوا لَهُمْ وَ لَا صَلَّوْا إِلَیْهِمْ وَ لَکِنَّهُمْ أَحَلُّوا لَهُمْ حَرَاماً فَاسْتَحَلُّوهُ وَ حَرَّمُوا عَلَیْهِمْ حَلَالًا فَحَرَّمُوهُ.
31.fa: به خدا سوگند! به خاطر کشیشها و رهبان‌های خود روزه نگرفتند و نماز نخواندند، بلکه آن‌ها (رهبانها) چیزی را حلال کردند و این‌ها پیروی نمودند و چیزی را حرام نمودند و اینان قبول کردند.
31.en: By God, they did not fast for them nor did they pray to them; rather, they (the priests and monks) made a forbidden thing lawful for them, so they deemed it lawful, and they made a lawful thing forbidden for them, so they deemed it forbidden.
31.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 6, p. 116
31.refs: Mustadrak al-Wasa'il, Vol. 17, p. 307; Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 24, p. 247; Al-Burhan; Wasa'il al-Shi'ah, Vol. 27, p. 134; Al-Ayyashi, Vol. 2, p. 87

31.ar: وَ اللَّهِ مَا صَلَّوْا لَهُمْ وَ لَا صَامُوا وَ لَکِنْ أَطَاعُوهُمْ فِی مَعْصِیَةِ اللَّهِ.
31.fa: به خدا قسم، برای آنان نماز نگزاردند و روزه نگرفتند، بلکه در معصیت خدا از آنان اطاعت کردند.
31.en: By Allah, they did not pray for them, nor did they fast for them; rather, they obeyed them in the disobedience of Allah.
31.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 6, p. 116
31.refs: Wasa'il al-Shia, Vol. 27, p. 133/ Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 2, p. 97/ Al-Burhan/ Al-Mahasin, Vol. 1, p. 246/ Nur al-Thaqalayn

31.ar: أَمَا إِنَّهُمْ لَمْ یَتَّخِذُوهُمْ آلِهَةً إِلَّا أَنَّهُمْ أَحَلُّوا لَهُمْ حَلَالًا فَأَخَذُوا بِهِ وَ حَرَّمُوا حَرَاماً فَأَخَذُوا بِهِ فَکَانُوا أَرْبَابَهُمْ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ.
31.fa: آن‌ها را خدای خود قرار ندادند، بلکه هر حلالی را که آن‌ها حلال کردند، ایشان پیروی نمودند و هر حرامی را که حرام نمودند ایشان قبول کردند و در برابر خدا، خدایان آن‌ها شدند.
31.en: Know that they did not take them as gods, but rather, they made lawful for them what was lawful, and they followed it, and they made forbidden what was forbidden, and they accepted it; thus, they became their lords instead of Allah.
31.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 6, p. 116
31.refs: Wasa'il al-Shi'ah, Vol. 27, p. 134 / Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 9, p. 212 / Al-Burhan / Nur al-Thaqalayn / Al-Ayyashi, Vol. 2, p. 86

31.ar: فَأَمَّا مَا جَاءَ مِنْ ذِکْرِ الشِّرْکِ فِی کِتَابِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَی فَمِنْ أَرْبَعَةِ أَوْجُه ... وَ أَمَّا الْوَجْهُ الثَّانِی مِنَ الشِّرْکِ فَهُوَ شِرْکُ الْأَعْمَالِ قَالَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَی وَ ما یُؤْمِنُ أَکْثَرُهُمْ بِاللهِ إِلَّا وَ هُمْ مُشْرِکُونَ وَ قَوْلُهُ سُبْحَانَهُ اتَّخَذُوا أَحْبارَهُمْ وَ رُهْبانَهُمْ أَرْباباً مِنْ دُونِ اللهِ أَلَا إِنَّهُمْ لَمْ یَصُومُوا لَهُمْ وَ لَمْ یُصَلُّوا وَ لَکِنَّهُمْ أَمَرُوهُمْ وَ نَهَوْهُمْ فَأَطَاعُوهُمْ وَ قَدْ حَرَّمُوا عَلَیْهِمْ حَلَالًا وَ أَحَلُّوا لَهُمْ حَرَاماً فَعَبَدُوهُمْ مِنْ حَیْثُ لَا یَعْلَمُونَ فَهَذَا شِرْکُ الْأَعْمَالِ وَ الطَّاعَاتِ.
31.en: As for what has been mentioned regarding shirk (polytheism) in the Book of Allah the Exalted, it is of four types... And as for the second type of shirk, it is the shirk of deeds. Allah the Exalted says: "And most of them believe not in Allah except while they associate others with Him" (Yusuf: 106). And His saying, glory be to Him: "They have taken their scholars and monks as lords besides Allah." Know that they did not fast for them, nor did they pray to them; rather, they commanded them and forbade them, and they obeyed them. They declared the lawful as forbidden for them and the forbidden as lawful for them, so they worshipped them without realizing it. This is the shirk of deeds and acts of obedience.
31.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 6, p. 116
31.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 69, p. 100 / Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 90, p. 61

31.ar: وَ أَمَّا أَحْبَارُهُمْ وَ رُهْبَانُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ أَطَاعُوا وَ أَخَذُوا بِقَوْلِهِمْ وَ اتَّبَعُوا مَا أَمَرُوهُمْ بِهِ وَ دَانُوا بِمَا دَعَوْهُمْ إِلَیْهِ فَاتَّخَذُوهُمْ أَرْبَاباً بِطَاعَتِهِمْ لَهُمْ وَ تَرْکِهِمْ أَمْرَ اللَّهِ وَ کُتُبَهُ وَ رُسُلَهُ (فَنَبَذُوهُ وَراءَ ظُهُورِهِمْ وَ مَا أَمَرَهُمْ بِهِ الْأَحْبَارُ وَ الرُّهْبَانُ اتَّبَعُوهُ وَ أَطَاعُوهُمْ وَ عَصَوُا اللَّهَ وَ رَسُولَهُ.
31.fa: امّا احبار و راهبان ایشان را اطاعت کرده و هرچه آن گروه گفتند؛ راهبان هم آن را ترویج کردند، و عقائد آن‌ها را نشر نمودند، آن‌ها آن جماعت را برای خود ارباب گرفتند، و امر خدا و رسول و کتاب خدا را رها ساختند و آن را پشت سر افکندند. (آل عمران/۱۸۷) و هرچه احبار و راهبان گفتند بکار بستند و آن‌ها را اطاعت کردند. و خداوند و رسولش را نافرمانی نمودند.
31.en: As for their rabbis and monks, they obeyed them, accepted their words, followed what they commanded them to do, and adopted the beliefs they invited them to. Thus, they took them as lords by obeying them and abandoning the command of Allah, His Books, and His Messengers (they cast it behind their backs). They followed and obeyed what the rabbis and monks commanded them, and disobeyed Allah and His Messenger.
31.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 6, p. 116
31.refs: Nur al-Thaqalayn / Al-Burhan / Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 9, p. 211 / Al-Qummi, Vol. 1, p. 288 / Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 69, p. 94

31.ar: مَنْ أَطَاعَ رَجُلًا فِی مَعْصِیَةِ اللَّهِ فَقَدْ عَبَدَهُ.
31.fa: کسی که در معصیت خدا از کسی اطاعت کند، مسلّما او را عبادت کرده است.
31.en: Whoever obeys a man in an act of disobedience to Allah has certainly worshipped him.
31.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 6, p. 118

31.ar: عَنْ عَدِیِّ بْنِ حَاتَمٍ قَالَ أَتَیْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) وَ فِی عُنُقِی صَلِیبٌ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ فَقَالَ یَا عَدِیُّ اطْرَحْ هَذَا الْوَثَنَ مِنْ عُنُقِکَ قَالَ فَطَرَحْتُهُ وَ انْتَهَیْتُ إِلَیْهِ وَ هُوَ یَقْرَأُ هَذِهِ الْآیَةَ اتَّخَذُوا أَحْبارَهُمْ وَ رُهْبانَهُمْ أَرْبابا حَتَّی فَرَغَ مِنْهَا فَقُلْتُ لَهُ إِنَّا لَسْنَا نَعْبُدُهُمْ فَقَالَ أَ لَیْسَ یُحَرِّمُونَ مَا أَحَلَّ اللَّهُ فَتُحَرِّمُونَهُ وَ یُحِلُّونَ مَا حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ فَتَسْتَحِلُّونَهُ قَالَ فَقُلْتُ بَلَی قَالَ فَتِلْکَ عِبَادَتُهُمْ.
31.fa: عدی‌بن‌حاتم گوید: نزد رسول‌خدا (صلی الله علیه و آله) آمدم درحالی‌که صلیبی از طلا به گردنم بود. به من فرمود: «ای عدی! این را از گردنت بردار». گفت: «آن را برداشتم». ایشان درحال خواندن این آیه از سوره‌ی برائت بود: اتَّخَذُواْ أَحْبَارَهُمْ وَ رُهْبَانَهُمْ أَرْبَاباً، تا اینکه از خواندن آن فارغ شد. به او عرض کردم: «ما آنان را نمی‌پرستیم»؟ فرمود: «مگر آنچه را خدا حلال نموده است تحریم نمی‌کنند و شما نیز آن‌ها را تحریم نمی‌کنید و آنچه را خدا حرام کرده است، حلال نمی‌کنند و شما نیز آن‌ها را حلال نمی‌دانید»؟ گفت: «بلی». فرمود: «عبادت ایشان این‌گونه است».
31.en: 'Adi ibn Hatim said: I came to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) while I had a cross of gold around my neck. He said, "O 'Adi, cast this idol away from your neck." I cast it away and approached him while he was reciting this verse: "They have taken their scholars and monks as lords..." until he finished it. I said to him, "We do not worship them." He replied, "Do they not forbid what Allah has made lawful, so you forbid it, and do they not make lawful what Allah has forbidden, so you deem it lawful?" I said, "Yes." He said, "That is their worship."
31.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 6, p. 118
31.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 9, p. 98; al-Burhan; Nur al-Thaqalayn

31.ar: یَا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ اتَّبِعُوا أَخِی وَ وَصِیِّی عَلِیَّ بْنَ أَبِی طَالِبٍ (علیه السلام) بِأَمْرِ اللَّهِ وَ لَا تَکُونُوا کَالَّذِینَ اتَّخَذُوا أَرْبَاباً مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ تَقْلِیداً لِجُهَّالِ آبَائِهِمُ الْکَافِرِینَ بِاللَّهِ.
31.fa: ای بندگان خدا! به دستور خداوند، از برادر و وصیّ من علیّ‌بن‌ابی‌طالب (علیه السلام) پیروی کنید و مانند کسانی نباشید که [از روی تقلید از پدران جاهلشان که به خداوند کافر بودند] معبودانی در مقابل خدا قرار دادند.
31.en: O servants of Allah! By the command of Allah, follow my brother and my successor, Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him), and do not be like those who took lords other than Allah, out of imitation of their ignorant forefathers who disbelieved in Allah.
31.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 6, p. 118

31.ar: أَمَّا الْمَسِیحُ (علیه السلام) فَعَصَوْهُ وَ عَظَّمُوهُ فِی أَنْفُسِهِمْ حِینَ زَعَمُوا أَنَّهُ إِلَهٌ وَ أَنَّهُ ابْنُ اللَّهِ وَ طَائِفَةٌ مِنْهُمْ قَالُوا ثَالِثُ ثَلَاثَةٍ وَ طَائِفَةٌ مِنْهُمْ قَالُوا هُوَ اللَّهُ.
31.fa: امّا مسیح (علیه السلام)؛ بعضی او را چنان بزرگ شمردند تا جایی که برای او ادّعای الوهیّت کردند و اینکه او پسر خداست. گروهی از آنان نیز به تثلیث قائل شدند و گروهی از آنان گفتند که او خداست.
31.en: As for the Messiah (peace be upon him), they disobeyed him while exalting him in their own minds when they claimed that he was a god and that he was the son of God. A faction among them said he is the third of three, and a faction among them said he is God.
31.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 6, p. 118
31.refs: Nur al-Thaqalayn / Al-Burhan / Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 9, p. 211 / Al-Qummi, Vol. 1, p. 288 / Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 69, p. 94
